name: switch-ruling-02-encode-selects-by-the-label-written
reference: spec 0.30 ruling 2: a kind's `as` key counts as mapped from the start of its kind for a `switch`, a common one from its own line on; 0.20 Encode: the case is the one decode would select from the bits the key's line wrote: w's `when` writes 1 (case 1, z), x's writes 2 (y in 16 bits)
